name: smwpatches-chucks-with-extra-bit-retain-type-when-hurt
title: Chucks With Extra Bit Retain Type When Hurt
description:
This patch adds a feature to the Chucks where if their extra bit is set, they will remember and revert back to their original type when hurt, instead of all turning into a Chargin' Chuck (except Whistlin' Chuck, who already has this mechanic implemented).

For this patch to work properly, you must run PIXI on the ROM at least once.

Requested by idol.
